subtitle: Independent, ward-wise monsoon risk indicators — built from open forecast and historical flood data.
disclaimer: This is an unofficial community project, not a government warning system. For official alerts, follow NDMA SACHET, IMD, and your city's municipal authority. Scores are risk indicators to help you decide when to pay closer attention — they are not evacuation orders.
verify_intro: Anonymous, unverified reports from the last 2 hours. If you're in the area, confirm or dispute what you see.
recent_reports_empty: No reports in the last 2 hours for this city.
vote_error: Couldn't record your vote — you may have already voted on this one.
report_intro: Unverified citizen reports, shown as counts alongside the computed scores above. One report per area every 15 minutes per device.
report_cooldown: You've already reported for this area recently — thanks. Try again later.
report_error: Couldn't submit — please try again in a moment.
reports_disabled: Citizen reports are temporarily disabled by the site admin.
pattern_convective_burst: Rain concentrated in a few intense hours (thunderstorm-driven)
pattern_prolonged_system: Sustained rain over most of the window (depression/cyclone-driven)
pattern_moderate_monsoon: Typical distributed monsoon rainfall, no sharp peak
feedback_reason_worse: {count} of {total} recent reports say worse than shown
feedback_reason_better: {count} of {total} recent reports say better than shown
location_note: City defaults to your detected location (GPS or approximate network location); language defaults to your browser's language. Change either anytime above.
